verdict.rationale: OneDrive has no user-facing automation or rules feature in the evidence. It does document developer building blocks that an external app could use to run background workflows: Graph change notifications that alert when files are created, updated or deleted, delta queries for change tracking, and resumable upload sessions. This counts only as partial support that needs custom code and outside tooling. Missing for 10: a native no-code automation or rules builder, scheduled or triggered workflows hosted by OneDrive itself, agent or AI-driven background tasks, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of autonomous automation use.
